items.source: Batches are atomic by default. In the context of a Cassandra batch operation, atomic means that if any of the batch succeeds, all of it will. Statement order does not matter within a batch. ReactiveCassandraBatchOperations applies all rows using the same timestamp if supplied, otherwise Cassandra will generate a timestamp.
items.translation: 默认情况下，批处理是原子的。在 Cassandra 批处理操作的上下文中，原子性意味着如果批处理中的任何一条语句成功，则所有语句都将成功。批处理内的语句顺序无关紧要。ReactiveCassandraBatchOperations 接口在提供 timestamp 时，会使用相同的 timestamp 应用所有行；否则，由 Cassandra 生成时间戳。

items.source:
Multi partition batches should only be used to achieve atomicity for a few writes on different tables. Apart from
this they should be avoided because they’re too expensive. Single partition batches can be used to get atomicity and
isolation, they're not much more expensive than normal writes.
items.translation: 多分区批处理仅应用于少数跨不同表的写入操作以实现原子性。除此之外，应避免使用它们，因为其成本过高。单分区批处理可用于实现原子性和隔离性，其开销与常规写入相差不大。
